title: Underwriting Manual: Open Enrollment, Guaranteed Issue, Decision Deadlines and Waiting Periods by Plan Letter
content:
Five terms govern how an application under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies is taken and how soon it must be decided, and two govern the waiting period for a condition treated before issue.

| Policy | Open enrollment period, calendar months | Offered on a guaranteed issue right | Health questions asked outside open enrollment and guaranteed issue | Underwriting decision deadline, calendar days | Contestability period, calendar months | Waiting period for a condition treated before issue, calendar months | Waiting period shortened or removed by prior creditable coverage |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 6 | yes | yes | 15 | 24 | 6 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 6 | yes | yes | 15 | 24 | 6 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 6 | yes | yes | 15 | 24 | 6 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 6 | no | yes | 20 | 24 | 6 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 6 | yes | yes | 15 | 24 | 6 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 6 | yes | yes | 12 | 24 | 6 | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 6 | no | yes | 12 | 24 | 6 | yes |

### Notes to the underwriting terms

The open enrollment period runs 6 calendar months on every letter, the contestability period 24 calendar months, and the waiting period for a condition treated before issue 6 calendar months; prior creditable coverage shortens or removes that waiting period on every letter. Health questions are asked outside open enrollment and a guaranteed issue right on every letter.

Two terms separate the letters. A guaranteed issue right is offered on Plan A, Plan B, Plan D, Plan N and Plan G, and is not offered on Plan K or High Deductible Plan G. The underwriting decision deadline is 15 calendar days on Plan A, Plan B, Plan D and Plan N, 20 calendar days on Plan K, and 12 calendar days on Plan G and High Deductible Plan G.
